title: post api auth login with valid admin credentials
description: Test the POST /api/auth/login endpoint with valid admin email and password to verify it returns a 200 status with a JWT token and admin profile.

title: get api sneakers with filters
description: Test the GET /api/sneakers endpoint with various query parameters such as brand, category, and search term to verify it returns a 200 status with a filtered array of sneaker objects.

title: post api orders with valid order data
description: Test the POST /api/orders endpoint with a valid order payload including items, customerName, phone, and address to verify it creates an order and returns a 201 status with the order object.

title: post api admin sneakers with valid jwt and product data
description: Test the POST /api/admin/sneakers endpoint with a valid JWT token and valid product data to verify it creates or updates a sneaker product and returns a 200 status with the sneaker object.

title: post api s3 presign with valid jwt and filename
description: Test the POST /api/s3/presign endpoint with a valid JWT token and valid filename and contentType in the request body to verify it returns a 200 status with presigned upload information.

title: get api health returns uptime and health info
description: Test the GET /api/health endpoint to verify it returns a 200 status with uptime and basic health information in JSON format.

title: get ready returns 200 when db is reachable
description: Test the GET /ready endpoint when the database is reachable to verify it returns a 200 status indicating readiness.

title: get ready returns 503 when db is unavailable
description: Test the GET /ready endpoint when the database is unavailable to verify it returns a 503 status indicating the database is unavailable.

title: rate limiting enforces 100 requests per 15 minutes per ip
description: Test the global rate limiting by sending repeated requests to GET /api/sneakers from the same IP to verify that up to 100 requests succeed with 200 status and the 101st request returns a 429 rate limit exceeded error.
